-- Spec: append a copy of s to the borrowed list dst, editing it in place.

-- Pure model of the effect: the list after appending s.
appended(xs: List[str], s: str) -> List[str] =
  pre xs.len() >= 0
  post out.len() == xs.len() + 1
  ex appended([], "a") == ["a"]
  ex appended(["a"], "b") == ["a", "b"]
  var r: List[str] = copy xs
  r.append(copy s)
  r

add_name(var dst: List[str], s: str) =
  pre dst.len() >= 0
  post dst.len() >= 1
  ex appended([], "a") == ["a"]
  dst.append(copy s)
